u0: Initial exploration phase: the agent has not yet seen the matching key. The key is hidden somewhere in one of the three left-column rooms, so the immediate objective is to search those rooms, opening unlocked doors as needed, until the key comes into view.
u1: The matching key is in view (key_found latched true) but the agent is not yet carrying it. Next objective: move to the key's cell and pick it up to obtain the matching key.
u2: The agent holds the matching key (has_matching_key). Next objective: navigate to the locked door guarding the target room and toggle it open (requires the key); the locked door is the target room's only entrance.
u3: The locked target door is open and the agent still has the key in hand. Next objective: drop the key, then walk through the open doorway into the target room (the doorway cell counts as entered) so the key no longer occupies the hand.
u4: The agent has entered the target room (target_room_entered latched true) and the door is open. Next objective: locate the mission's ball inside the room and pick it up with empty hands to complete the mission.
u5: Terminal success state: the mission's ball has been picked up and the episode ends; no further objective, the agent stays here.
